decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (Photo Montage, Design and Access Statement, Drawing Numbers A461 MO3, A461 M02, A461 M01, A461 02, A461 01, received 15/03/10. A461 O3B received 26/05/10.) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - Details of joinery shall be in accordance with the advice given in Technical Note 3 of the Bedford Park Society's handbook for residents and architects.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
description: Erection of a rear infill conservatory extension, a partial side and rear extension to link house to existing outbuilding, addition of pitched roof to outbuilding, conversion of existing outbuilding into habitable space, second floor rear dormer extension and internal and external alterations and refurbishments, including re-roofing with Rosemary Red clay tiles; repair, cleaning and re-pointing brickwork as required, repair and replacement of joinery to match original as required with double glazed windows in new extensions (Listed Building consent application)
